history_lifecycle.claim: MotiveRuntime history is explicitly bounded at 64 records per agent. The public current motive field is the latest retained record; a valid latest-only snapshot preserves current motive and configured profiles. No separate motive cold-history archive is claimed.

next_falsification_target: Phase 1P: continuity state ownership/minimization using the same source-first semantic-manifest workflow. Do not extend motives merely to accumulate more favorable numbers unless a concrete unresolved contract requires it.
non_claim: Phase 1O does not claim the public/persisted profile shape, history, history_limit, or global sequence can be removed. motive_id remains part of the current public profile contract even though it is key-derived. History remains observable audit state and owns the current motive record. The compact evaluator does not replace production validation or authority, and no motive cold archive is claimed.
phase1_owner_status: motives now have an explicit profile-ownership, redundant-id, compact-evaluation, prior-history causality, current-field, and bounded-history minimization record
supported_claim: Current MotiveRuntime stores configuration profiles and bounded audit history. Within each profile, motive_id is exactly reconstructible from the enclosing profile-map key; baseline and weights are independently evaluation-causal. A pure compact-profile evaluator reproduced 1,200 exact production motive records across 10 restart checkpoints. Reducing motive history to one latest record and history_limit to one preserved another 1,200 exact future records, current-motive views, and profile views while full public snapshots remained different. Motive history is explicitly bounded at 64 records per agent.
